errors.name: InvalidCoreContract
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when the Core dependency is not a valid StreamCore.

errors.name: InvalidMintLedgerContract
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when the ledger dependency is not a valid StreamMintLedger.

errors.name: InvalidMintPhase
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a phase identity is invalid.

errors.name: MintPhaseDoesNotExist
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a phase has not been configured.

errors.name: MintPhaseAlreadyConfigured
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when initial configuration is attempted for an existing phase.

errors.name: MintPhasePaused
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a configured phase is paused.

errors.name: MintPhaseNotStarted
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a phase has not started.

errors.name: MintPhaseEnded
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a phase has ended.

errors.name: UnauthorizedMintExecutor
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when the caller may not execute a phase.

errors.name: InvalidMintExecutor
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when an executor address is invalid.

errors.name: MintExecutorCountLimitExceeded
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a phase would exceed the launch executor hard cap.

errors.name: MintArrayLengthMismatch
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when request array lengths do not match.

errors.name: MintBatchQuantityLimitExceeded
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a request has no token or exceeds the phase cap.

errors.name: InvalidMintBatchLimit
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a phase batch limit is zero or above the launch hard cap.

errors.name: MintCounterCountLimitExceeded
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a phase configures more counters than launch allows.

errors.name: MintCounterCapExceeded
errors.natspec: @notice Deprecated compatibility error; counter cap enforcement now reverts from the ledger.

errors.name: InvalidMintRecipient
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a token recipient or beneficiary is zero.

errors.name: InvalidMintCounter
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a configured counter is invalid for the launch-static manager.

errors.name: DuplicateMintCounter
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a counter ID appears more than once in a phase.

errors.name: UnsupportedMintCounterMode
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a counter mode is reserved for a future manager.

errors.name: MintCounterSubjectMissing
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a counter subject cannot be derived.

errors.name: MintPolicyHashRequired
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a caller does not bind execution to the active policy hash.

errors.name: MintPolicyHashMismatch
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a caller supplies a stale or unexpected phase policy hash.

errors.name: MintAuthorizationRequired
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a caller does not provide a replay-protected authorization ID.

errors.name: InvalidMintModuleRegistry
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when the module registry dependency is invalid.

errors.name: InvalidMintGate
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a configured gate is invalid for launch policy.

errors.name: MintGateNotActive
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a gate is not active for the required interface.

errors.name: MintGateCodehashChanged
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a gate's codehash no longer matches the phase pin.

errors.name: MintGateValidationFailed
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when gate validation fails.

errors.name: MintGateNullifiersUnsupported
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a gate returns unsupported nullifiers.

errors.name: MintGateQuantityExceeded
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a gate returns too small a quantity limit.

errors.name: MintGateAuthorizationMismatch
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when request and gate authorization IDs conflict.

errors.name: MintGateAuthorizerMismatch
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when request and gate authorizers conflict.

errors.name: MintGateHashRequired
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a gate returns no durable evidence hash.

events.name: MintPhaseConfigured
events.natspec: @notice Emitted when a phase is configured and registered in the ledger.

events.name: MintPhasePausedEvent
events.natspec: @notice Emitted when a phase pause flag changes.

events.name: MintPhaseExecutorUpdated
events.natspec: @notice Emitted when an executor is enabled or disabled for a phase.

events.name: MintCounterConfigured
events.natspec: @notice Emitted for each counter configured under a phase policy.

events.name: MintPhaseGateConfigured
events.natspec: @notice Emitted when a phase binds an optional gate module.

events.name: MintGateValidated
events.natspec: @notice Emitted after a gate validates one prepared mint batch.

events.name: MintPreparedBatchExecuted
events.natspec: @notice Emitted once per prepared batch after all tokens complete.

events.name: MintPreparedTokenExecuted
events.natspec: @notice Emitted once per prepared token completed by the manager.

functions.name: configurePhase
functions.natspec: @notice Configures and registers a launch-static phase policy.

functions.name: setPhaseExecutor
functions.natspec: @notice Enables or disables a caller for a configured phase.

functions.name: setPhasePaused
functions.natspec: @notice Pauses or unpauses a configured phase.

functions.name: mintPrepared
functions.natspec: @notice Consumes ledger counters, prepares, and completes a mint batch atomically.

functions.name: phase
functions.natspec: @notice Returns immutable phase config plus existence.

functions.name: phasePolicyHash
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the active manager policy hash for a phase.

functions.name: phaseExecutor
functions.natspec: @notice Returns whether an executor may call a phase.

functions.name: phaseCounterIds
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the ordered counter IDs for a phase.

functions.name: phaseGate
functions.natspec: @notice Returns one phase's optional gate config.

functions.name: previewSubjectKey
functions.natspec: @notice Previews the manager-derived subject key for one token/counter context.

functions.name: previewCounterValueKey
functions.natspec: @notice Previews the canonical ledger value key for a derived subject.

definition.name: IStreamMintManager
definition.natspec: @notice Interface for outside-Core phase policy and mint execution.
